title: In a shallow clone name git fetch --unshallow origin in every lifecycle-history refusal and refuse change new before writing
description: In a shallow clone name git fetch --unshallow origin in every lifecycle-history refusal and refuse change new before writing
acceptance_criteria: (1) In a depth-1 and a depth-50 clone of an adopted project, change new, change status, change check and change audit refuse, saying the clone is shallow and naming git fetch --unshallow origin; after that fetch they behave as in a full clone. (2) A refused change new leaves no .specsync/changes/<id>/. (3) In a full clone a baseline whose cutoff is not an ancestor keeps today's message, and a corrupt correction ledger keeps its own. (4) The tester's two shapes (a depth-1 clone with no origin ref; a shallow clone with origin/main but not the merge-base) name the fetch.

answers.constraints: REQ-change-108: a refused change new writes nothing; REQ-change-142: fail closed when Git cannot answer; a full clone keeps today's messages; the shallow message is the one model already in historical_definition_digest_matches.rs
